== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=tg-03-city-of-light|The Damascans are the people of the nation of [[Damasca]], a kingdom that has been ruled by a royal bloodline for approximately three hundred and fifty years. The nation's prosperity was historically maintained through the use of Territories, which allowed for secure borders and easy access to resources like food, bypassing the need for traditional infrastructure. This stability was managed by the royal family's unique ability to control the [[Hanging Tree|Hanging Trees]] and the entities sealed beneath them. To protect their realm, the first [[King of Damasca]] used his powers as a [[Traveler]] to seal away a dangerous force. This security has been maintained through the annual sacrifice of nine lives. The [[Damascan]] military is noted for its strength and discipline, consisting of soldiers in various uniforms who operate in organized ranks or on horseback. These troops have been regarded as legendary, acting as extensions of the ruler's [[Authority|authority]]. Socially, a distinction exists between city dwellers or those with long-standing heritage who use family names, and those living in remote fringe villages who use their father's name. While the kingdom includes many outlying villages, these residents often feel separate from the central government. Politically and spiritually, [[Damasca]] has been shaped by powerful figures known as [[Incarnations]] and [[Travelers]]. The current leadership involves the [[Incarnation of Ragnarus]], following a period where an [[Avernus Incarnation|Incarnation of Avernus]] exerted mental control over the citizenry. The nation has faced significant conflict, including battles with [[Valinhall]] and [[Enosh]] aggressors, and has been accused by some of tyranny and cruelty due to its methods of maintaining power.}}
